classifications.rationale: The President presently blocks the property and property interests of foreign persons who are later determined by Treasury, in consultation with State, to satisfy the stated criteria; the legal consequence attaches upon such a determination by operation of this segment.
classifications.evidence: All property and interests in property that are in the United States, that hereafter come within the United States, or that are or hereafter come within the possession or control of any United States person of the following persons are blocked

classifications.rationale: The segment inseparably combines mandatory interagency coordination by the National Security Advisor, an internal-management action, with a present expansion of the transactions prohibited for blocked persons, a self-executing legal consequence.
classifications.evidence: The prohibitions in section 1 of this order include: (a) the making of any contribution or provision of funds, goods, or services

classifications.rationale: The President presently makes the statutory impairment determination concerning specified donations, which is a legally consequential predicate under IEEPA rather than a direction for an agency to reach a later outcome.
classifications.evidence: I hereby determine that the making of donations of the types of articles specified in section 203(b)(2) of IEEPA

classifications.rationale: The President presently prohibits the specified donations, evasion transactions, attempted violations, and conspiracies; those legal prohibitions arise from the segment itself.
classifications.evidence: Any conspiracy formed to violate any of the prohibitions set forth in this order is prohibited.

classifications.rationale: The President presently suspends immigrant and nonimmigrant entry for persons meeting the incorporated criteria, subject to specified exceptions determined by State or Homeland Security.
classifications.evidence: the entry of such persons into the United States, as immigrants or nonimmigrants, is hereby suspended

classifications.rationale: The segment combines mandatory agency implementation and procedure-setting with a command that covered persons receive an incorporated legal treatment, plus operative definitions; these materially different postures cannot be assigned one non-mixed code.
classifications.evidence: Such persons shall be treated by this section in the same manner as persons covered by section 1 of Proclamation 8693

classifications.rationale: The President makes a supporting administrative finding about why advance notice would frustrate asset measures, but this segment neither itself eliminates notice nor otherwise changes a person's legal position.
classifications.evidence: prior notice to such persons of measures to be taken pursuant to this order would render those measures ineffectual

classifications.rationale: The President presently determines that no advance notice is required for section 1 listings or determinations, immediately altering the applicable procedural duty.
classifications.evidence: there need be no prior notice of a listing or determination made pursuant to section 1 of this order

classifications.rationale: This section heading identifies a provision but contains no actor, action, object, or legal consequence.
The President delegates implementation and rulemaking authority to Treasury and permits internal redelegation; it authorizes later action without dictating a particular legal outcome.
classifications.evidence: The Secretary of the Treasury may, consistent with applicable law, redelegate any of these functions within the Department of the Treasury.

classifications.rationale: The segment combines a mandatory agency implementation direction and internal savings clauses with a present exception allowing specified official-business transactions, producing materially different postures within one segment.
classifications.evidence: Nothing in this order shall prohibit transactions for the conduct of the official business of the Federal Government or the United Nations
